title: Act to be in addition to certain enactments
text:
23. Act to be in addition to certain enactments.—The provisions of this Act shall be in addition to

and not in derogation of the provisions of the Passport (Entry into India) Act, 1920 (34 of 1920), [the
Emigration Act, 1983 (31 of 1983)] the Registration of Foreigners Act, 1939 (16 of 1939), the Foreigners
Act, 1946 (31 of 1946), , Trading with the Enemy (Continuance of Emergency Provisions)
(16 of 1947), the Foreigners Law (Application and Amendment) Act, 1962 (42 of 1962), [the Foreign
Exchange Regulation Act, 1973 (46 of 1973)] and other enactments relating to foreigners and foreign
exchange.
